summary: Iteration 4 focused on two user-reported visual regressions fixed in css/theme.css: (1) missing dropdown caret on active nav dropdown items and (2) missing/misaligned green check icons in industry usecase lists. Both are fully resolved. Verified caret + underline coexistence, dropdown open behaviour, and icon-vs-li parity on all 7 industry pages at 375/768/1440. No regressions observed in nav height, fonts, primary button, footer, horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: css/theme.css: switching the active underline to ::before is the correct fix since Bootstrap's dropdown-toggle owns ::after for the caret. Consider adding a brief comment above the .nav-link.active::before block to document this coupling with Bootstrap to prevent future regressions.
usecase-grid grid layout is clean; consider row-gap on top of column-gap so vertical spacing scales similarly at all breakpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 1 (dropdown caret) verified via computed style: ::after borderTopWidth = 4px on both nav-solutions-link and nav-industries-link on ALL 9 tested pages (industries index, 7 industry pages, solutions.html). Active underline drawn by ::before with rgb(90, 48, 241) on the currently-active dropdown link. Bug 2 (usecase icons) verified: liCount === iconCount on banking(13), real-estate(8), professional-services(10), manufacturing(8), healthcare(7), legal-services(7), information-technology(7) at 375/768/1440. Zero clipped/hidden icons. Dropdowns still open on click (Solutions and Industries menus become visible). Note: the usecase section uses data-testid$='-usecases' (NOT id$='-usecases') — use the data-testid selector when re-testing.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: earlier .navbar-signulu .nav-link.active::after was used to draw the purple underline for the active nav item, but Bootstrap's .dropdown-toggle class uses ::after for the caret triangle. On pages where a dropdown link (Solutions/Industries) was active, the active-state ::after overrode the caret content, making the caret disappear. Fix: moved the active underline to ::before, freeing ::after for Bootstrap's caret. Bug 2 RCA: the previous .usecase-grid used CSS multi-column layout, which orphaned some list items across columns and clipped their leading ::before-driven or inline icon markers, producing missing/half-rendered check icons. Fix: replaced with CSS grid (1/2/3 column responsive) so each <li> owns a full grid cell with its icon.
